proof_body:
by
  intro K V _ _ _ f h
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  have hx : f (f x) = f x := LinearMap.congr_fun h x
  have h1 : f x ∈ Module.End.eigenspace f 1 := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr (by rw [hx, one_smul])
  have h0 : x - f x ∈ Module.End.eigenspace f 0 := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr (by rw [map_sub, hx, sub_self, zero_smul])
  have : x = f x + (x - f x) := by abel
  rw [this]
  exact Submodule.add_mem_sup h1 h0
target_source: ∀ (K V : Type*) [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (f : Module.End K V), f ∘ₗ f = f → Module.End.eigenspace f 1 ⊔ Module.End.eigenspace f 0 = ⊤
